docs.title: Home
docs.text:
Commandr CLI

The ultimate automation tool for modern developers.

Get Started View on GitHub Technical Excellence

Commandr CLI is engineered for performance. Built with a zero-dependency mindset in Python, it provides a robust framework for automating complex local and cloud workflows.

High Performance

The core engine is optimized for sub-millisecond execution times and minimal memory footprint.

Pythonic Architecture

Leverage the full power of the Python ecosystem to extend functionality with custom plugins.

DevOps Integrated

Standardized hooks for Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines come pre-configured out of the box.

Live Preview zsh — cmdr $ cmdr init project-alpha [INFO] Environment configuration successfully generated. $ cmdr deploy --prod [SUCCESS] Production deployment sequence complete.

docs.title: Introduction
docs.text: Welcome to the Official Commandr CLI Documentation!

docs.title: What is Commandr CLI?
docs.text:
Commandr CLI is a CLI that currently has around 1300 commands and is made by me, just a single developer on one huge project. I am to add a total of around 15000+ Commands in total. It has many commands which are inspired by other Software Distribution Software, meaning that its an app that lets you to install apps. Such as pacman. Pacman has a total of around 294 Packages from MSYS2.

Info

The Creator(s) of Commandr CLI do not own MSYS2 and is not associated in any way.

docs.title: What is Commandr CLI?
docs.text: Commandr CLI is a CLI (or TUI) that aims to have the best user experience, customization and many features. It has a collection of different environment toolsfor different tasks across different Operating Systems.

docs.title: What is a TUI?
docs.text: A TUI is a Terminal user interface. We are currently making Commandr CLI into both a TUI and CLI. The Terminal User Interface idea came from freebuff or codebuff. As it is already a TUI, I was interested in making Commandr CLI itself a TUI for users that prefer TUIs over CLIs.

docs.title: But why use TUIs?
docs.text: Altough TUIs are not really needed for the primary user experience, It is good to have TUIs incase you are lazy or basically dont have a mouse. Since TUIs mainly rely on the keyboard, You can just use the Arrow Keys and WASD to contol or navigate through the TUI.
